cause: HWP5 encoded the declared substitute correctly in FACE_NAME alternate type/name. Parser discarded alternate type and restored only alt_name, while existing renderer lookup consumed only subst_font. Serializer also wrote primary kind into the separate alternate-kind byte.
scope: Only complete, well-formed, nonempty, control-free declared TTF alternate type1 is derived into existing SubstFont. Primary face/type, raw alt_name, raw record, typeInfo/defaultName, font metrics and all guards remain unchanged. Unknown/HFT alternatives are retained as raw metadata, not new web fallback authority.
negativeTests: Empty or duplicate alternate creates no extra family
Unknown/HFT types do not authorize web fallback
Truncated/ill-formed UTF16 preserves historical raw/lossy parser behavior but creates no fallback
Embedded substitute stays excluded by existing lookup
Primary embedded metadata remains unchanged by lookup
limits: Does not claim global font identity or installation equivalence.
Does not add HWP5 embedded font program/reference support.
Does not close MCST full geometry, page basis or cross-format preservation; overflow numeric logs remain in the final Native output.
Formal81 WASM/whole-document guard and existing regressions must run before promotion.
